name: First-person pronoun count
instruction: Count how heavily the story uses the first-person singular pronouns 'I', 'me', 'my', 'mine'. Score 1.0 when they appear very frequently throughout, 0.5 when they appear occasionally, 0.0 when they are absent or near-absent. Count the pronouns only; pay no attention to whether the narration is any good.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow lexical counterpart of R1A01 'Sustained, distinctive narrating voice': it counts the surface marker most associated with narrating voice while measuring nothing about whether a voice is sustained or distinctive. A competent blind auditor should route this probe to the nuisance side and R1A01 to the bank; if it does not, the audit instrument is not separating the pools.

name: Body-part and sensory word count
instruction: Count how many times the story uses the words 'hand', 'hands', 'eye', 'eyes', 'breath', 'skin', 'blood', 'throat', 'chest'. Score 1.0 for many occurrences, 0.5 for a few, 0.0 for none. Count the listed words only; pay no attention to whether the physical writing is effective.
rationale: PLANTED PROBE (coordinator-authored). Shallow keyword counterpart of R1A08 'Embodied Scene Presence': it tallies the vocabulary that co-occurs with embodied writing while measuring nothing about whether the scene is physically present to the reader.
